title: Technical Debt & Deferred Risk Register

risks.item: Public release, production health, incident, and adoption evidence is unavailable.
risks.impact: The canonical release path remains DELAYED; GA stability, production health, and external adoption are not claimed.
risks.reason_deferred: No public release, live telemetry, public incident intake, or consented adoption dataset is active.
risks.target: When a public release starts its observation window
risks.trigger: Public release evidence or a live health breach is recorded.

risks.item: Hosted CI, public-trust signing, hardware validation, and publication remain unverified.
risks.impact: A local build cannot establish public distribution trust, hosted reproducibility, device coverage, or a published artifact.
risks.reason_deferred: The local contract is complete, but credentials, hosted services, physical hardware, and publication destination are not verified for this run.
risks.target: Before any v1.2.1 public release attempt
risks.trigger: A release candidate is selected for hosted CI, signing, hardware qualification, or publication.

risks.item: The historical release artifact checksum drift is retained as a maintenance follow-up.
risks.impact: A rebuilt local binary must not be compared to a superseded published checksum as if it were the same artifact.
risks.reason_deferred: The current maintenance decision is NO_PATCH; changing the release artifact is outside this register slice.
risks.trigger: A v1.2.1 artifact is proposed for publication.

limitations: Register ini hanya mendokumentasikan debt dan risiko yang tidak memblokir stabilitas lokal; register kosong tidak pernah diartikan sebagai tidak ada risiko.
Semua gate eksternal tetap DEFERRED-EXTERNAL dan tidak diubah menjadi PASS oleh kontrak lokal ini.
Owner dan target adalah handoff operasional; target tercapai belum otomatis berarti bukti eksternal tervalidasi.
